title: STDec: Spatio-Temporal Stability Guided Decoding for dLLMs
abstract: arXiv:2604.06330v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) have achieved rapid progress, viewed as a promising alternative to the autoregressive paradigm. However, most dLLM decoders still adopt a global confidence threshold, and do not explicitly model local context from neighboring decoded states or temporal consistency of predicted token IDs across steps. To address this issue, we propose a spatio-temporal stability guided decoding approach, named STDec. We observe strong spatio-temporal stability in dLLM decoding: newly decoded tokens tend to lie near decoded neighbors, and their predicted IDs often remain consistent across several denoising steps. Inspired by this stability, our STDec introduces spatial-aware decoding and temporal-aware decoding. The spatial-aware decoding dynamically generates the token-adaptive thresholds by aggregating the decoded states of nearby tokens. translated_title: STDec：面向扩散大语言模型的时空稳定性引导解码方法
translated_abstract: 扩散大语言模型取得了快速进展，被视为自回归范式的一种有前景的替代方案。然而，大多数dLLM解码器仍采用全局置信度阈值，既没有显式建模来自邻近已解码状态的局部上下文，也没有建模预测token ID跨步骤的时序一致性。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种时空稳定性引导的解码方法，命名为STDec。我们观察到dLLM解码过程中存在显著的时空稳定性：新解码的token往往位于已解码邻居附近，且其预测的token ID通常在多个去噪步骤中保持一致。受这种稳定性的启发，STDec引入了空间感知解码和时序感知解码：空间感知解码通过聚合邻近token的已解码状态，动态生成token自适应的阈值；时序感知解码则对预测ID跨步骤保持一致的token放宽解码阈值。
tldr: 该论文提出STDec方法，利用dLLM解码中“新token靠近已解码邻居、预测ID跨步骤保持一致”的时空稳定性，通过空间感知与时序感知解码动态自适应地调整阈值，从而改进解码效果。
en_tdlr: STDec exploits the spatio-temporal stability in dLLM decoding—newly decoded tokens lie near decoded neighbors and their predicted IDs remain consistent across denoising steps—to dynamically adapt decoding thresholds via spatial-aware and temporal-aware decoding.
